description: Find one-way flights to use as an onward ticket. Returns up to 10 flights, each with an id to buy and its price in USD.

date.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, within 9 months. Defaults to 14 days from now.

destination.description: IATA code of where the onward flight goes, e.g. "SIN"

origin.description: IATA code of the airport leaving the country the traveller is entering, e.g. "BKK"

name: search_flights
title: Search onward flights
